results.title: Lab Rat
results.overview: A deflated human test subject deals with the struggles of his strange career, and dares to break free and find his true passion.

results.title: Travel Reminiscence
results.overview: At a London community centre, facilitators and volunteers run a travel-themed session for people living with dementia and their families, friends and carers.  Together, the group embarks on a playful journey: discussing past trips, revisiting these through theatre, and writing postcards to loved ones.

results.title: Adore Him
results.overview: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

results.title: Gansey
results.overview: As a woman washes and puts a Guernsey jumper out to dry, the symbolism of the jumper and the design of its stitches creates a sense of identity for the island.

results.title: FUN
results.overview: Kneading the back of an elderly man, Evie, the new masseuse at the Russian & Turkish bathhouse, finds her mind drifting from the steam room’s promise of serenity toward an absurd vision of grief.

results.title: THOUSAND AND ONE COMMUNISTS
results.overview: The film unfolds over two days in the life of Aashik, a young activist in the Marxist party’s youth wing in Kerala. He and his comrades navigate a world increasingly defined by war, inequality, and political disillusionment—forces that steadily erode Aashik’s mental well-being. Though his personal life offers him little comfort or joy, he remains unwavering in his commitment to political struggle, channeling his turmoil into activism.  As tensions escalate and hope feels distant, the film culminates in a powerful final sequence: civil society flooding the streets, united in resistance and demanding a more just future. In this convergence of collective anger and collective hope, Aashik’s world finds the possibility of renewal.

results.title: El Círculo
results.overview: After several failed attempts to contact Juliet through a ritual. Leo, Taurus and Aquarius will have to face the consequences of their betrayals and lies.

results.title: Regulars
results.overview: On Halloween night in a Brooklyn dive bar, where a group of misfit regulars — led by a Dominican-American bar owner — get trapped and uncover a murder, spiraling into a chaotic, culture-soaked whodunnit where everyone’s got secrets… and everyone’s a suspect.

results.title: The Flesh Dress
results.overview: Jean, an old tailor nostalgic for his bygone past, is terrified of growing old. He can no longer bear mirrors that reflect the loss of his happy youth with his wife Jeanne.

results.title: TS-CAM
results.overview: The commission of a triptych sends a guilty painter into a downward spiral.

results.title: Вторая Таня
results.overview: Thirty-five-year-old Tanya is a successful modern resident of St. Petersburg. In the evenings, she attends acting classes, where she is assigned to prepare a monologue based on the Siege diary of a woman also named Tanya. Tanya, in the present, begins to imagine herself in the place of Tanya from the past. The two realities gradually intertwine.

results.title: The Shoe
results.overview: After entering a mysterious shoe repair shop,  a young man discovers his shoe no longer fits trapping him in a place where even escape feels impossible.

results.title: Gorda y divina
results.overview: Before the spotlight and the wig, there is work almost nobody sees: makeup, costumes, performance and social media. This documentary follows drag artists off the stage and asks which bodies are allowed to shine.

results.title: Grit: The Fire Chief Luis Nevarez Story
results.original_title: Grit: The Fire Chief Luis Nevarez Story
results.overview: The true story of Fire Chief Luis Nevarez, who overcame a life-changing accident and personal trauma to become a leader and inspiration.

results.title: Rasathi Unna Kanatha Nenju
results.overview: Rasathi Unna Kanatha Nenju is an emotional romantic drama about Varun and Vaidehi, a married couple whose relationship suffers due to unspoken emotions, childhood trauma, and a lack of understanding. As their marriage falls apart, they must confront their fears and mistakes to rediscover their love and rebuild their relationship.

results.title: Libertad
results.overview: After surviving a near-fatal assault, an Indigenous, transgender teen escaped Mexico 30 years ago, eventually becoming a trans healthcare provider in California. When her mother’s health starts to decline back in Mexico, she risks it all by petitioning for asylum as her only chance of seeing each other again before it’s too late.

results.title: T.P.I.D. (The Priest is Dead)
results.overview: a priest is found dead inside his church, a newcomer becomes suspicious when the congregation greets his death with smiles instead of grief, leading him to uncover a disturbing secret.
